title: Held Light
description: A darker, melody-led garage roller: a relentless plucky detuned arpeggio threads the whole track while a half-time DMX kick swings underneath with shuffled ghost hats. A chopped, pitched vocal phrase is woven through the arp, a saturated sub and a lush sidechained pad pump against the kick, and the filter and register slowly open across the arc before stripping back to just arp and breath.
